claim: In the air the player keeps most of his steering: ProcessInput scales forward acceleration by 1 - height/kDudeAirborneHeight (256), and a standing jump's height above the floor (pXSprite->height, (floorZ - bottom) >> 8) peaks near 60, so about 77% of air control remains at the apex. MoveDude's ground drag is scaled the same way and switched off entirely past kDudeAirborneHeight, so over a DEEP pit a running leap has no braking; in the bot's runs on AGTST15 (2026-08-27) a leap held forward flew about 3,000 units whatever it was aimed at. A jump fires only on a fresh press: cantJump clears when the button is released, not on landing.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/player.cpp:1779-1783 (ProcessInput, air acceleration), :1840-1841, :1855, :1863 (ProcessInput, cantJump); actor.cpp:4922-4926 (MoveDude, drag by height); actor.cpp:4906 (MoveDude) height = (floorZ - bottom) >> 8; actor.h:186 kDudeAirborneHeight 0x100; the apex of a standing jump is about 15,370 z (see a-standing-jump-rises-under-a-body).

Seen in bot runs on AGTST15 (2026-08-27, a test map not in the corpus; not repeated): every hop between 1,024-wide stepping stones 600 apart over a damage pit overshot until the push was released early.
use: Stepping stones over a deep pit need landing room along the flight, or a shallow pit so drag still acts; a gap the player must clear by running is sized by how long forward is held, not by take-off speed alone.

checked.how: player.cpp:1779-1783 (ProcessInput): speed = 0x10000 - divscale16(height, kDudeAirborneHeight), branch only while height < kDudeAirborneHeight (actor.h:186, 0x100); :1840-1841 cantJump cleared when jump not held, :1855 jump needs !cantJump and height==0, :1863 sets it. actor.cpp:4906 (MoveDude) height = ClipLow(floorZ-bottom,0)>>8; :4922 returns past 256, :4926 drag scaled by height. 15370>>8=60, 1-60/256=0.77. The 3,000-unit flight is a bot-run observation (memory bot-leaping), not repeatable here.
